records.scope: Explicitly named mature Eddy W, sampled in the northern Cape Basin in February 2000. Individual source-case reference, not a family constant.

calculation.allowance_basis: OSW sensitivity assumption of half the printed 0.1-degree increment per coordinate, not source-reported position accuracy.

records.period_label: February 2000 station pair; exact edge-station date and simultaneity unverified
records.source_locator: Table 1 and section 2, printed page 42 / PDF page 2; section 4.2, printed page 44 / PDF page 4. Figure 1 is dated 18 February; center sampling is explicitly 22 February.
records.definition: Great-circle separation between table station 06, described as the sampled center, and station 05, described as the edge. OSW calculation from published coordinates; not an author-reported radius.
records.qualification: Sampled station separation, not whole-eddy radius or diameter. Haversine on a 6371 km sphere. OSW assumes ±0.05° per printed coordinate as sensitivity only; triangle inequality bounds the four coordinate perturbations, then rounds outward to 25 km. Source position accuracy, center/edge definition, exact edge sample date, simultaneity and movement corrections are unquantified. The interval is not measurement uncertainty, confidence, physical min/max or a seasonal range. No radius doubling, area, closed boundary or state containment inferred.
